Name: Measure DAX variables should start with '_'
Description: VAR names in measures should be prefixed with '_' (e.g. VAR _sales) to tell variables apart from columns and measures. Heuristic — assumes space-separated 'VAR name'. Fix: run scripts/fix-measure-variables.cs (renames declaration + references; dry-run first).

Name: Measure missing metadata tag
Description: Every measure should carry a [Type: ..., Created on: ..., Created by: ...] tag at the end of its Description (stamp it with scripts/add-measure-metadata-tags.cs).

Name: Visible column has no description
Description: Every visible column should carry a description so report authors and consumers know what it means. Hidden/technical columns (keys, underscore-prefixed) are exempt.

Name: Numeric column/measure has no format string
Description: Numeric columns and measures must set a FormatString so values render consistently (thousands separators, decimals, %). Non-key numeric columns and all measures are checked.
